sub_strands.name: Number Concept and Whole Numbers
performance_indicators: Count concrete items forward and backward sequentially from 1 up to 1,000.
Read and write whole numbers from 1 up to 1,000 in symbols and words.
Identify the place value of digits up to hundreds (hundreds, tens, and ones) using place value devices.

sub_strands.name: Operations
performance_indicators: Add up to two 3-digit numbers with regrouping up to a sum of 1,000.
Subtract up to 3-digit numbers with regrouping up to 1,000.
Multiply single-digit numbers by numbers up to 10 using arrays and repeated addition.
Divide numbers up to 50 using exact grouping concepts without remainders.

sub_strands.name: Fractions and Patterns
performance_indicators: Identify and represent eighths (1/8) using concrete geometric cutouts.
Complete missing terms in complex arithmetic sequences that progress up to 1,000.

sub_strands.name: Length, Mass, and Capacity
performance_indicators: Measure and record length of surfaces using standard meters (m) and centimeters (cm).
Measure mass in kilograms (kg) using a beam balance and standard weights.
Measure capacity of various fluid containers accurately using standard liters (l).

sub_strands.name: Time and Money
performance_indicators: Read and tell time on an analog clock to the nearest five minutes.
Relate days, weeks, and months using a standard annual calendar layout.
Count money and work out change using Kenyan currency denominations up to 500 Shillings.

sub_strands.name: Lines and Shapes
performance_indicators: Draw and differentiate between straight, curved, horizontal, and vertical lines.
Identify and sketch basic 2D shapes (rectangles, circles, triangles, squares) based on their structural properties.

sub_strands.name: Oral Communication and Auditory Focus
performance_indicators: Pronounce vocabulary words containing advanced consonant blends and digraphs correctly.
Listen attentively to short narratives and accurately summarize key events in sequence.
Initiate and sustain conversations on familiar themes with peers using correct sentence structures.

sub_strands.name: Fluency and Literacy Skills
performance_indicators: Read grade-level texts aloud fluently with appropriate expression, pacing, and intonation.
Apply structural and phonetic decoding skills to understand unfamiliar words independently.
Locate specific details and draw simple inferences from short reading passages.

sub_strands.name: Composition and Mechanics
performance_indicators: Write legibly and neatly using correct letter formations and consistent paragraph spacing.
Construct coherent short paragraphs using correct punctuation rules (capital letters, commas, full stops).
Spell complex grade-appropriate vocabulary accurately during independent composition.

sub_strands.name: Utamkaji na Maongezi
performance_indicators: Kutamka sauti tata na maneno marefu ya Kiswahili kwa ufasaha na lafudhi sahihi.
Kushiriki katika mijadala ya vikundi darasani kwa kutumia lugha ya adabu na msamiati mwafaka.
Kueleza kwa mtiririko ufaao matukio na visa vilivyoshuhudiwa au kusikilizwa.

sub_strands.name: Kusoma kwa Ufasaha na Ufahamu
performance_indicators: Kusoma vitabu na vifungu vya hadithi kwa kasi, ufasaha, na kuzingatia alama za vituo.
Kufafanua maana ya maneno mapya kwa kutumia muktadha wa kifungu kinachosomwa.
Kujibu maswali ya moja kwa moja na yale ya kiuchambuzi kutoka kwa makala yaliyosomwa.

sub_strands.name: Uandishi wa Insha na Tahajia
performance_indicators: Kuandika aya zilizopangwa vizuri kwa mwandiko nadhifu na tahajia zilizo sahihi.
Kutungatunga sentensi na vifungu vifupi vya ubunifu kuhusu mada teule za kijamii.

sub_strands.name: Weather, Environment, and Soil
performance_indicators: Analyze and interpret weather trends over a month using standard symbols and charts.
Demonstrate methods of caring for local soil types and practical conservation measures.
Identify common plants and animals in the wider community and list their ecological benefits.

sub_strands.name: Hygiene and Health Management
performance_indicators: Practice advanced personal cleanliness routines, including safe handling of sharp grooming tools.
Identify the causes of common localized illnesses and describe preventative steps.
Practice safe storage and disposal methods for food items at home and school.

sub_strands.name: Community Administration and Culture
performance_indicators: Identify the administrative leadership roles in the wider community or sub-county.
Describe key cultural values, symbols, and artifacts that promote unit in the locality.

sub_strands.name: Safety and Disaster Awareness
performance_indicators: Identify unsafe situations, environments, or stranger behaviors and outline response protocols.
Demonstrate basic first aid actions for minor cuts, pricks, or bruises during play activities.

sub_strands.name: Creative Expressions and Forms
performance_indicators: Create drawings and paintings incorporating basic shading techniques to show form.
Produce decorative border patterns on fabrics using block printing and stencil tools.
Weave or model structural items using locally available natural or synthetic fibers.

sub_strands.name: Rhythm and Dramatic Performance
performance_indicators: Sing complex multi-verse topical and national songs with correct pitch, phrasing, and posture.
Dramatize short skits or poems expressing positive moral themes with matching expressions.

sub_strands.name: Gymnastic and Athletic Movements
performance_indicators: Perform simple gymnastic actions such as forward rolls and safe weight transfers.
Demonstrate structured running, dodging, and spatial positioning during competitive team games.

sub_strands.name: Biblical Values and Leadership
performance_indicators: Identify key biblical characters who demonstrated obedience and leadership (e.g., Moses, David).
Retell narratives regarding the miracles of Jesus and deduce the values they convey.
Demonstrate honesty, unity, and respect in their daily interactions inside and outside the school.

sub_strands.name: Quran, Hadith, and Sirah
performance_indicators: Recite and understand the core messages of specified short Surahs, including Surah Al-Maun.
Explain the significance of the pillars of Iman and their practical expressions in character.
Emulate the moral qualities (Akhlaq) modeled by Prophet Muhammad in everyday life.

sub_strands.name: Moral and Character Development
performance_indicators: Demonstrate consistency in practicing core moral values like integrity, respect, and self-control.
Resolve peer conflicts peacefully and constructively during collaborative tasks.
Internalize positive behavior patterns and community values through institutional mentorship.
